title: Scenario-driven reporting request templates for enterprise tenants
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a small library of scenario-driven request templates and an evidence rubric to standardize intake for enterprise console/reporting asks. Goal: reduce back-and-forth with customers, speed triage, and ensure requests land in the correct delivery lane (self-serve, product backlog, concierge). Templates will cover common enterprise scenarios (one-off exports, scheduled tenant-level dashboards, cost attribution requests, ad-hoc investigative slices, and compliance-oriented audit exports). Each template will include required fields, minimum acceptance evidence, suggested priority lane, estimated cost bucket, and default owner. Deliverables: 5 template JSONs, UI copy for the Console request form, a short playbook for support/solutions, and a lightweight routing rule set (mapping from template to SLA/owner).
acceptance_criteria: Five distinct scenario templates authored: One-off export, Scheduled tenant dashboard, Cost breakdown by label, Incident-driven ad-hoc slice, Compliance audit package
Each template defines: required inputs, example payload, nonfunctional constraints (RTO, retention), minimum evidence (sample queries or dataset IDs), and suggested priority lane
Routing matrix that maps template -> default owner (Support, Solutions, PM backlog, Eng spike) and SLA band (24h / 72h / 2 weeks)
Console request form updated with scenario dropdown and contextual guidance copy for each template
Playbook published to Confluence with 3 example customer flows and escalation checklist
Telemetry: record template chosen and final routing decision (for 30-day analysis)
